title: Print and PDF handoff
blurb: Two copies of one invoice card printed side by side. One stays inside a drawable canvas during print; the other moves out to plain DOM on beforeprint with moveBefore() and moves back on afterprint.
question: When a page prints or saves to PDF, does Chromium preserve selectable vector text and clickable links from a drawable <canvas>, or flatten them to a bitmap? And can beforeprint and Element.prototype.moveBefore() extract live HTML out of a drawable canvas for vector printing and put it back on afterprint without losing input state or focus?
